digest.component_or_area: Jira DC harness - field readiness gate
propositions: The DC harness session-start readiness gate waited for Epic Link and Epic Name fields before any Jira Software project existed, creating an ordering deadlock where the gate blocked the action that could provision those fields

GreenHopper provisions Epic Link and Epic Name only when the first Software project is created, not at plugin startup, making them unavailable during session initialization regardless of timeout budget
The field readiness check must move from session start to after project provisioning in _assert_project_capabilities, the only point where the fields can exist

The decision rule in not_ready_message claiming that zero customfield_* entries indicates incomplete plugin startup is wrong for instances with no projects and must be corrected to prevent future misdiagnosis
